description: This file defines the `Challenge` class which models a stateless challenge prompt in a user interface, including its prompts, reason, and display titles.

classes.name: Challenge
classes.description: Represents a stateless challenge prompt with prompts, reasons, and display titles.

methods.name: Challenge
methods.description: Constructor initializing Challenge instance with prompts, reason, cancelability, and optional headers.

methods.name: modalTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the modal based on the challenge reason.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Returns the heading text for the challenge modal, varies with reason.

methods.name: subheading
methods.description: Returns the subheading text for the challenge modal, if applicable.

methods.name: hasPromptForValidationType
methods.description: Checks if any prompt matches a specific validation type.
